main_text.l: tis, pedes in Patriæ incrementum litoribus
efferte feliciter. Macti este & Vos Virtutibus,
FRANCISCE LEOPOLDE, ADAME FRIDERICE,
JOHANNES GOTLOBI, CAROLE ALBERTE, Ba-
rones SCHÖNAICHII, teneri Virtutum Avita-
rum Surculi, & in spem surgentis Seculi feli-
citer adolescite. Tibi vero inprimis advol-
vor, Perillustris Domine, FRANCISCE, Baro
SCHÖNAICHI, Tu Gloria es Silesiæ ac Lusatæ
Nobilitatis, Columen Annosæ SCHÖNAICHI-
ORUM Virtutis; Annosam enim non abs re
Virtutem in Te voco, qvi superstitem Terris
servas, quæ cum Beatissimis Fratribus Tuis ad
Cœlum evolatura videbatur. Tu servas eam,
& in Illustribus Nepotibus ad Æternitatem
firmas. Macte, Perillustris Baro, ifthoc ro-
bore & in Patriæ decus ac perennem Illustris
Familiæ Salutem diutissime supera. Sine me,
Domine Benignissime, finite universi ita Vo-
tis Vos prosequi, cui extra Vocem & Vota observantiam te-
standi materies non est, finite in humillimum cultus Vestri
Testimonium extare tenuem hanc Operam, quæ unice per
vos vivere gestit, qvæ ex Virtute Vestra prægnantiori luce
resplendebit. Ita Deus Vos longissime sospitet
ILLUSTRITUDINUM VESTRARUM
Observantissimus Cultor
J. C. BECMANUS, D.

page.notes: The line "tis Vos prosequi ..." is set in smaller type but is the continuation of the sentence, so it is kept in the paragraph. The first line is a fragment carried over from the previous page. Some letters are worn, notably in "Ita Deus Vos" and the signature "BECMANUS", which reads "BECMANUS" in print; "Macti este" and "Macte" may be printed with variant spellings, copied as seen. Some spots and specks on the scan are ignored.
